contract: PET-1: Config.WalkSpeed(class, petSpecies, petLv, kaiju) = Config.Player.WalkSpeed x class WalkSpeedMult x (1 + Config.PetSpeedBonus(species, lv)), no skill buff (A23-49), at most Config.Speed.Cap (1.35) x the base. Baby slime +7% at pet Lv1 -> +10% at Lv10 (straight line, levels clamped 1..Config.Pets.MaxLv). An Active kaiju gets no pet bonus. PlayerService.ComputeWalkSpeed reads the class (classDef), EquippedPet / PetLv and KaijuService.GetState (pcall); applyStats (spawn / RefreshCharacter) and RefreshSpeed (WalkSpeed only, live humanoid) are the only player WalkSpeed writes; PetService publish calls RefreshSpeed. ZoneService.checkMove never flags any class x pet level x kaiju at its speed (dt 0.05-3 s) or the cap.
limitations: No zone / combat / grudge-sack speed rule exists today, so those states trigger no recompute (a later rule adds its trigger next to its input). Real character physics and network jitter are not modelled.
